name: adopt-repo-standards
job: Bring a concrete repository onto the engineering baseline: constitution projection, project facts, fences, conformance entrypoints, retire predecessor layouts.

inScope: Wiring required baseline surfaces on their owning paths
Retiring predecessor instruction layouts and dual authority stacks
Fixing missing or stale manifest, fences, and conformance entrypoints
outOfScope: Unrelated product features in the target repository
Forever-dual AGENTS layouts or permanent parallel instruction stacks

inputs: Target repository and its delivery terminal
Required surfaces (constitution projection, manifest, fences, checks)
outputs: Baseline surfaces wired on the owning paths of the target repo
Working conformance entrypoints and declared checks
Predecessor dual layout retired or a dated residual with an owner

data: current target repo structure and instruction layout
permissions: write access to the target repository or a PR path into it

failureSemantics: Adoption fails closed: entrypoints that do not resolve, conformance checks that do not run as declared, or an unverified predecessor retirement mean the cycle is not done; local versus landed claims stay honest.

outcome.observable: Entrypoints resolve and conformance checks run as declared in the target repo, and the predecessor dual instruction authority is retired or a dated residual with an owner for the framed scope.
